description: A single-use token sent by e-mail for verification or password reset (table ONE_TIME_TOKEN).

user_id.description: Owner of the token, the _id of a document in users.

token_hash.description: SHA-256 of the token, 64 lower-case hex digits.

expires_at.description: Moment the token stops working (UTC); a TTL index removes the document later.

used_at.description: Moment the token was used, null or absent while unused.
